publication_type_basis: The publication presents classifier criteria as a guideline.

entries.summary: GENEA mutation defines Fixture Entity One subject to blast thresholds and a fixture-defining fusion exclusion.
GENEB mutation refines an existing diagnostic category without changing the major category.
GENEC has both adjusted negative and earlier univariable adverse prognostic findings.
A constitutional GENED variant predisposes to the fixture myeloid neoplasm.
